gate-exchange-assets-manager 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Gate account and asset manager composite skill.
- Unified workflow to query total assets, account balances, risk/margin/liquidation status, SimpleEarn/staking earnings, affiliate commissions, and perform unified-account borrowing/collateral/leverage settings.
- Routes requests across 58 deduplicated MCP tools (54 read, 4 write) from 7 L1 skills.
- Supports “signal overlay” multi-intent query detection for simultaneous asset, risk, yield, affiliate, and borrowing operations.
- Requires Gate API Key with specified permissions.
